description: This file defines a class Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Socket implementing a socket-based HTTP client adapter for Zend Framework, including methods for configuration, connection management, request writing, response reading, and cleanup.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Socket
classes.description: A socket-based HTTP client adapter class for Zend Framework, supporting connection setup, request transmission, response parsing, and connection teardown.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the adapter class, currently does nothing.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration options for the adapter, expects an array.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified host and port, with optional SSL and timeout settings.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with specified method, URI, headers, and body over the socket.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the HTTP response from the socket, handling headers, chunked transfer encoding, and content length.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that ensures the socket is closed when the object is destroyed.
